title: Auth — Challenge
description: Request a one-time challenge nonce that the subject will sign to prove control of their VID.

subject.description: The VID the producer intends to authenticate as. Optional — when omitted, the issuer MAY return a subject-agnostic challenge whose binding is established at authenticate time. When present, the issuer SHOULD bind the challenge to this subject so a successful authenticate proves control of THIS VID, not any VID.

purpose.description: Producer-declared intent (e.g. "login", "step-up", "sign-out"). Consumers MAY surface this in audit logs or use it to scope the issued nonce. Free-form; ecosystems define the vocabulary.

Response.title: Auth Challenge — response payload
Response.description: Issued by the auth service in reply to a challenge request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/auth/challenge/0.1#response.

challenge.description: base64url-encoded one-time nonce. MUST be at least 128 bits of entropy. The subject embeds this value into the auth/authenticate document they sign.

sessionId.description: Opaque, server-chosen identifier correlating this challenge with the subsequent authenticate call. The subject MUST echo it back unchanged. Consumers MUST treat the value as opaque.

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp after which the challenge MUST NOT be accepted. Issuers SHOULD pick a window between 30 seconds and 5 minutes.
